welcome.title: Welcome to BidStack 360°
welcome.body: Mantu's platform for bid and presales management. Get up to speed in under 2 minutes.

pipeline.title: Your sales pipeline
pipeline.body: Visualise and advance your opportunities through stages, from first contact to signed deal.

bidMatrix.title: Bid/No-Bid Matrix
bidMatrix.body: Objectively evaluate every bid using Mantu's weighted criteria before deciding to respond.

dustAgents.title: Dust AI Agents
dustAgents.body: Ask your AI agents to prepare proposals, summarise meetings, or enrich accounts.

integrations.title: Connect your tools
integrations.body: Sync Gmail, Microsoft 365, Slack and your business tools to centralise information.

quickStart.title: Start now
quickStart.body: Create your first opportunity, invite your team and explore your personalised dashboards.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.subtitle: Get from zero to piloting your first bid.

createOpportunity.label: Create an opportunity
createOpportunity.description: Add your first bid to the pipeline

configureStages.label: Configure stages
configureStages.description: Tailor the pipeline to your sales process

quickStart.completedBody: You now know the essentials of BidStack 360°. Good luck with your bids.

profile.label: Complete your profile
profile.description: Add your name, photo, and timezone so teammates can find you.

template.label: Pick a template pipeline
template.description: Choose B2B SaaS, Agency, Enterprise, or Inside Sales as a starting point.

firstLead.label: Add your first lead
firstLead.description: Capture inbound interest and let BidStack score it automatically.

firstActivity.label: Log your first activity
firstActivity.description: Record a call, email, or note against any contact.

firstBidNoBid.label: Run your first bid/no-bid
firstBidNoBid.description: Score an opportunity on fit, value, and win probability before you commit.

firstRfp.label: Start your first RFP response
firstRfp.description: Spin up a structured response and let the agents draft the first pass.

firstDeal.label: Create your first deal
firstDeal.description: Convert a lead or add a deal directly to the pipeline.

inviteTeam.label: Invite your team
inviteTeam.description: Collaboration works best with the whole team in one place.

complete.title: You're all set!
complete.message: Your workspace is ready to pilot bids.

templatePicker.subtitle: Each template sets up a pipeline with stages and a handful of sample records so you can explore right away. You can remove the sample data any time.
